Spaghetti Celesti: Devour the Heavens

A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, and Linux

Benvenuti a Spaghetti Celesti!

Here we only serve the most perfect forchettata di spaghetti you've ever eaten. The longest pasta, generously garnered with little foods, and perfectly rolled... Per favore, have a seat and prepare to devour the heavens!

Plays with a controller or with a keyboard. Includes a completo tutorial!

Made in 7 days for Falling Block Jam 2026, kindly hosted by davemakes!

Original concept, gameplay, code and graphics by Lorandbehold, and music by Pentadrangle! Follow us on Bluesky!

Spaghetti Celesti: Devour the Heavens will be in our new project PUNKCAKE BUFFET, with a couple different levels and a delightful story. Wishlist it now to get news!

Join our Discord to chat with us and other community members about Spaghetti Celesti and PUNKCAKE BUFFET!

Presskit:

Are you press, a streamer, or someone who makes videos about games? Please feel free to cover Spaghetti Celesti and the PUNKCAKE BUFFET project. You can find our presskit here!

The presskit contains screenshots of the game, some different backgrounds, title art on a transparent background, and a 1920x1080 spaghetti frame with a transparent background.

Thanks to everyone streaming the game and making videos!

Changelog:

Oct. 4th 2026:

  • Made spaghetti appear a little bit more often in the queue.
  • Added a wishlist button - we have a Steam page!
  • Added the option to switch to english in the settings.
  • Fixed a typo on the title screen.

Oct. 2nd 2026:

  • Fixed a bug where the shutdown fade would flash random colors.
  • Fixed another bug where the music wouldn't resume on exiting the pause menu.

Notester826 days ago(+4)

Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa, this is so good! :D I love the floppy spaghetti pieces and how you have to try to avoid a couple "gotcha"s during play, such as making a 3x2 closed loop (meaning nothing else can get added to it) and having spaghetti ends point downward (though it's not impossible to link a downward-pointing spaghetti, just tricky). It's also really satisfying to lay out a bunch of ingredients and drop a spaghetti to attach onto all of 'em!

Regarding the fork, it's nice that you can stab it into 2 tiles, which can help with adding an extra ingredient onto a spaghetti chain, or even grabbing 2 spaghetti chains (which can be nice for getting rid of those aforementioned 3x2 closed loops without tanking your restaurant rating)! Also appreciate the ability to cancel your fork by hitting a fork block! (Juicy sound and animation for such tooo!) And bless you for allowing the player to rotate the fork for fun~ -u-

Another very different and interesting falling block game overall (and dope music from Pentadrangle again! The intro music that played as the game was loading made me excited to make some spaghetti, and the in-game track is catchy too)! Feels like I traveled into the future to play a later Punkcake release cause I can't believe I played this for free...and an extended version's on the way... ;u;
